cards.title: While the model is paused
items: Model calls are paused (CLAUDE_PAUSED = true, since 2026-09-28); turning them on means changing that constant and deploying. There is no owner switch.
Every free-tool submit answers 503 'paused': 'The free tools are paused for now. Please check back later.'
The pause is checked before the rate limit, so no daily use is spent. A production deployment with no API key is paused too.
Copy is unreachable, since no tool returns output while paused.
Sample chips only pre-fill chat; nothing reaches a model until Send.

cards.title: Refusals and limits
items: Free tools: 5 runs a day per IP, 50 per signed-in account (429).
Support and affiliate forms: 10 per IP per hour (429) and required fields (400); an application without the consent box is refused (400).
Partner links: 60 per IP per hour; an unknown code just opens plain signup.
Wish votes: 60 per account per hour. Suggestions: 5 per account a day.
Signup and login accept next only when it starts with '/' but not '//' or '/\'; signed in, they send the person to /{lang}/app and a carried URL or partner code is dropped.

cards.title: Who can do this
items: Votes and suggestions need a session; any role may use them.
A vote is recorded under the account email, so a member votes as the owner's account.
A sample chip lands in chat only with a session and a workspace.
A session raises the free-tool ceiling from 5 to 50 a day.
The founder reads tickets and applications in the console Leads tab or by GET with isAdmin; nothing is sent back automatically.

cards.title: Prices quoted on these pages
items: Help answers and the Updates entries read prices, task costs and chat allowances from the tables; the image and video ranges are typed text.
Plans: Starter 299, Pro 499, Business 999 SAR a month, or Agency by contract.
Trial: 3 days, 50 credits, 30 chat messages, no card. Chat a month: Starter 250, Pro 650, Business 1,300.
First brand's setup is free; each added brand's setup from its URL is 9 credits.
Partner code: 15% off the first month; the partner earns 15% for 4 months.
